note: Driven by the main agent through the Paper MCP. cardId = Paper node id of the scene card. prompt/status = what Paper showed at the last sync. Each card is a frame named after its itemId; its text children are named item-id, summary, prompt and status ("Status: Draft" means draft).

cards.summary: Base reference: front bust, composed neutral face. Approve this first; every other Elena image copies it.
cards.prompt: Elena facing the camera, chest-up, composed and neutral: brows level, eyes attentive, mouth closed in a relaxed line, shoulders square. This is her master reference portrait: clear, evenly lit, every detail of her face, hair streak, earrings and outfit visible.

cards.summary: Three-quarter view turned to our left, neutral. Second reference.
cards.prompt: Elena in a three-quarter view turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes glancing back towards the camera, neutral composed expression, mouth closed. The silver streak at her left temple stays visible.

cards.summary: Mood face: bored, attention drifting (spark low).
cards.prompt: Elena facing the camera, bored: eyelids half lowered, gaze drifting to the side past the camera, brows flat, mouth closed in a slight polite downturn. Polite but clearly elsewhere.

cards.summary: Mood face: interested, leaning in.
cards.prompt: Elena facing the camera, interested: head tilted slightly forward, brows lifted a little, eyes focused and bright, a small closed-mouth smile.

cards.summary: Mood face: delighted, genuinely warm (spark full).
cards.prompt: Elena facing the camera, delighted: a wide genuine smile showing the top teeth, eyes crinkled, brows lifted, cheeks raised. Warm and open.

cards.summary: Mood face: skeptical, "Is that right?" (project review).
cards.prompt: Elena facing the camera, skeptical and questioning: one eyebrow raised slightly, eyes narrowed a touch and fixed on the camera, head tilted a few degrees, mouth closed in a neutral line. Waiting for an answer, not hostile.

cards.summary: Mood face: coolly disapproving, she has turned against you (project review loss).
cards.prompt: Elena facing the camera, coolly disapproving: brows lowered and drawn slightly together, eyes steady and unimpressed, mouth closed and pressed flat, chin lifted a little. Controlled, never shouting.

cards.summary: Clip: polite greeting nod, from neutral to interested.
cards.prompt: Elena starts neutral, then gives a small polite nod and her expression warms into a gentle closed-mouth smile. The camera slowly pushes in a little. Her mouth never opens; no speaking.

cards.summary: Clip: genuine laugh, from interested to delighted.
cards.prompt: Elena starts interested, then breaks into a genuine silent laugh: eyes crinkle, head tips back slightly, shoulders lift once, ending on her delighted face. The camera holds steady with a very slight push-in. No speech, no lip movement shaped like words.

cards.summary: Clip: glances down at her phone, from neutral to bored.
cards.prompt: Elena starts neutral, then lowers her eyes and tips her head down to glance at a phone held below the frame (the phone and her hands stay out of view), then looks back up with a bored, distracted expression. A faint cool screen glow touches her chin while she looks down. The camera stays still.

cards.summary: Clip: turns and walks out of frame (she escaped). Ends on the empty black background.
cards.prompt: Elena starts on her bored face, gives a brief polite nod, then turns to our left and walks out of the frame. The camera stays still. The clip ends on the plain black background with nobody in it.

cards.summary: Base reference: front bust, relaxed neutral face. Approve this first; every other Ryan image copies it.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, chest-up, relaxed and neutral: brows level, eyes friendly, mouth closed, shoulders loose. This is his master reference portrait: clear, evenly lit, every detail of his hair, stubble and shirt visible.

cards.summary: Three-quarter view turned to our left, neutral. Second reference.
cards.prompt: Ryan in a three-quarter view turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes glancing back towards the camera, relaxed neutral expression, mouth closed.

cards.summary: Mood face: easy lopsided grin, everything is fine.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera with his easy lopsided grin, closed mouth, one corner higher, eyebrows relaxed, eyes friendly.

cards.summary: Mood face: smug after shifting the blame.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, smug: one eyebrow slightly raised, eyes half-lidded, a small self-satisfied closed-mouth smirk, chin lifted a little.

cards.summary: Mood face: caught off guard when you answer back.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, caught off guard: eyebrows jump up, eyes wide, mouth closed or slightly parted, head pulled back a touch.

cards.summary: Mood face: defensive, tense.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, defensive: brows pulled together and down, eyes narrowed, jaw tight, mouth closed in a tense line, shoulders raised slightly.

cards.summary: Mood face: caught out, sheepish.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, sheepish: eyes glancing down and away, brows raised in the middle, an awkward closed-mouth half smile, neck slightly flushed.

cards.summary: Mood face: quietly annoyed.
cards.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, quietly annoyed: brows lowered, eyes rolled slightly to the side, lips pressed together, cheek muscles tight.

cards.summary: Clip: leans back, casual, from neutral to casual grin.
cards.prompt: Ryan starts neutral, then leans back slightly as if into a chair and settles into his easy lopsided grin. The camera eases back a little. No speaking.

cards.summary: Clip: glances sideways at you and settles smug.
cards.prompt: Ryan starts with his casual grin, flicks his eyes sideways towards our right (towards the player) for a beat, then looks back with a smug smirk. Hands stay out of frame. The camera pushes in slightly. No speaking.

cards.summary: Clip: the facts land, from smug to sheepish.
cards.prompt: Ryan starts smug, then his smirk fades, his eyebrows lift, and he looks down and away into a sheepish expression. The camera holds still. No speaking.

cards.summary: Clip: tenses up, from surprised to defensive.
cards.prompt: Ryan starts surprised, then his face tightens into a defensive look: brows pull down, jaw sets, shoulders rise slightly. The camera holds still with a slight push-in. No speaking.

cards.summary: Base frame for his clips: the existing calm meter face, redrawn at sheet framing (9:16, head in the centre square).
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, chest-up, calm and busy: exactly the expression of the calm meter face (brows level with a slight furrow, eyes steady, mouth closed in a flat line, shoulders square). Same head size and position as the calm meter face when cropped square. Nothing about his face, hair or suit changes.

cards.summary: Three-quarter view, turned to his right (our left), neutral busy expression.
cards.prompt: Marcus in a three-quarter view, head and body turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes looking slightly past the camera. Neutral, busy expression: brows level, mouth closed in a flat line. Same framing and lighting as the calm meter face.

cards.summary: Three-quarter view, turned to our right, neutral busy expression.
cards.prompt: Marcus in a three-quarter view, head and body turned about 35 degrees to our right, eyes looking slightly past the camera. Neutral, busy expression: brows level, mouth closed in a flat line. Same framing and lighting as the calm meter face.

cards.summary: Side profile facing left, reading something below frame.
cards.prompt: Marcus in a clean side profile facing our left, chin slightly lowered as if reading something below the frame. Calm, focused expression, mouth closed. Only head, neck and shoulders are visible.

cards.summary: Mood face: quietly disappointed (Saying no: "go on, I'll just do it myself").
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, quietly disappointed: brows raised slightly in the middle, eyelids a little lowered, mouth closed and pulled flat to one side, head tilted a few degrees. Not angry, just let down.

cards.summary: Mood face: relieved, the tension leaves his face (Saying no: you offer Monday noon; Confessing: you bring the fix).
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, relieved: brows relaxed and lifted, eyes softened, a small closed-mouth half smile, shoulders dropped a little. The tension has visibly left his face.

cards.summary: Mood face: steely and controlled (Confessing, after the reveal).
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, steely and controlled: jaw set, brows low and level, eyes steady and direct, mouth closed in a firm straight line. Serious but not shouting.

cards.summary: Mood face: caught off guard (Confessing: the moment you tell him).
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, caught off guard: brows lifted high, eyes wide, mouth closed or only slightly parted, head pulled back a touch.

cards.summary: Mood face: tired sigh, eyes closed (end frame of the sigh clip).
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera mid-sigh: eyes closed, brows drawn up in the middle, cheeks slightly puffed, lips closed, shoulders dropped. Weary, not angry.

cards.summary: Looks down at a phone held below frame (Confessing: the CFO email).
cards.prompt: Marcus facing the camera with his head tipped down, eyes looking down at a phone held below the bottom of the frame (the phone and his hands are NOT visible). A faint cool screen glow lights his chin. Brows starting to knit.

cards.summary: Clip (Saying no): a long weary sigh, from calm to sighing.
cards.prompt: Marcus starts calm, then closes his eyes and lets out a long, slow, silent sigh: his chest rises and falls, his shoulders drop and his brows draw up in the middle, ending on his weary sighing face. The camera holds still with a very slight push-in. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

cards.summary: Clip (Saying no): "Go on, I'll just do it myself", from calm to disappointed.
cards.prompt: Marcus starts calm, then his gaze drops away from the camera for a beat, his head tilts a few degrees and his mouth pulls flat to one side, ending on his quietly disappointed face. Not angry, just let down. The camera holds still. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

cards.summary: Clip (Saying no): you offer an alternative, from calm to relieved.
cards.prompt: Marcus starts calm and slightly tense, then his brows lift and relax, his shoulders drop and a small closed-mouth half smile appears, ending on his relieved face. The camera eases back a little. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

cards.summary: Clip (Confessing): the CFO email lands, from calm to reading the phone.
cards.prompt: Marcus starts calm, then his eyes and head tip down towards a phone held below the bottom of the frame (the phone and his hands are never visible). A faint cool screen glow rises on his chin and his brows start to knit, ending on the reading-phone frame. The camera stays still. No speaking.

cards.summary: Clip (Confessing): the news sinks in, from surprised to steely.
cards.prompt: Marcus starts caught off guard, then his face settles: his brows come down level, his jaw sets and his eyes fix steadily on the camera, ending on his steely face. Serious, not shouting. A slow, slight push-in. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

cards.summary: Clip (Confessing): you owned it and brought the fix, from steely to relieved.
cards.prompt: Marcus starts steely, then lets out a slow silent breath through his nose: his jaw unclenches, his brows relax and his shoulders drop, ending on his relieved face. The camera eases back a little. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

cards.summary: Front bust, soft neutral smile, at sheet framing (9:16). Her 9:16 base; the hint poster is only 480px square.
cards.prompt: Sarah facing the camera, chest-up, arms relaxed at her sides and out of frame, a soft closed-mouth smile, eyes bright and attentive.

cards.summary: Three-quarter view turned to our left, friendly.
cards.prompt: Sarah in a three-quarter view turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes glancing back towards the camera, soft closed-mouth smile. Hair falls naturally over her far shoulder.

cards.summary: Mood face: concerned for you (you are about to lose).
cards.prompt: Sarah facing the camera, concerned and caring: brows drawn up in the middle, eyes wide and soft, lips pressed together gently, head tilted slightly. Worried for the player, not scared.

cards.summary: Mood face: encouraging, "you've got this" (as she gives the hint).
cards.prompt: Sarah facing the camera, encouraging: bright eyes, eyebrows lifted, a warm wide closed-mouth smile, a small confident nod of the head.
